notice.title: Important Notice: Beware of Recruitment Scams
notice.description: We have been made aware of individuals impersonating our team and reaching out to job seekers via Telegram and other unofficial channels, falsely claiming to represent CoW DAO

never.title: We Never:
never.description:
- Ask for payment or wallet information during the hiring process.
- Request sensitive personal documents (e.g. passport) via chat apps.

actions.title: What You Should Do:
actions.description:
- Do not engage with suspicious messages claiming to offer you a job at CoW DAO.
- Do not share personal information, crypto wallet data, or make payments.
- Report impersonation attempts to us at [people@cow.fi](mailto:people@cow.fi).
- Report fake accounts directly on Telegram or to [abuse@telegram.org](mailto:abuse@telegram.org).

channels.title: Official Communication Channels:
channels.description:
All our hiring communications come from:

- Official emails are sent from the cow.fi domain.
- Telegram (we'll send confirmation email from the cow.fi domain).
- Verified listings on [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/company/cow-protocol) or official job boards.
- Official email or video conferencing platforms (Zoom, Meet).

closing.title: We are actively working to report and remove these impersonators. Your safety and trust are important to us.
closing.description:
Stay safe,  
The CoW DAO Team

faq.title: FAQs
faq.description: Looking for more details? Read the full documentation and FAQ.

items.title: Do I need approval to participate?
items.description: No. The Moo & Earn Affiliate Program is fully permissionless. Anyone can generate a referral link and start sharing immediately. No application, no whitelist, no waiting.

items.title: How do rewards work?
items.description: Rewards are triggered when wallets you refer hit qualifying trading volume milestones on CoW Swap. Both you and your referred traders can earn rewards depending on where they are in the milestone journey.

items.title: When are rewards paid?
items.description: Rewards are distributed every week in USDC. Hit a milestone, get paid - simple as that.

items.title: What counts as qualifying volume?
items.description: Only eligible trades on supported CoW Swap chains count toward milestone volume. Some trade types may be excluded based on program rules. Read the [full docs](https://docs.cow.fi/cow-protocol/affiliate-program/faq) for details.

items.title: Where can I get support?
items.description: The CoW Swap [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/cowprotocol) is the best place to ask questions, get help, or connect with the community.
